time.desc: The family members of the students involved publicly responded to the controversy, denying the existence of sexual harassment and saying they had filed a complaint against the school's disciplinary sanctions and that related infringement disputes have entered judicial proceedings.
The accuser formally filed a lawsuit with the court regarding the dispute over liability for sexual harassment damages and completed the filing of the case
The civil dispute between the two parties surrounding the alleged facts has been progressed through multiple closed hearings in the court.
The court issued a first-instance judgment, concluding that the existing evidence was insufficient to confirm sexual harassment and rejecting all claims of the accuser.

The university involved issued an official response to the public opinion triggered by the verdict, stating that it would launch a review investigation into school disciplinary sanctions and related academic integrity issues.
Social platforms issued governance announcements to permanently ban accounts that impersonate identities and spread false information.
